tokens_version_restamp: 2.1.0 -> 2.3.0 on 2026-08-04 by /idea-render-mockup. NOT a re-render. Tokens 2.2.0 and 2.3.0 are additive on the colour and type surfaces a preview consumes. states[].hash was NOT recomputed and is unchanged — this stamp asserts palette currency only, not full input-SHA currency.
grouping_note: 5 date-group headers over 10 transactions — the count that proves grouping actually groups (TC-TXN-001). The period summary strip renders totalCredit £2,400.00 and totalDebit £1,394.04 from demo-data.
pending_note: SPOTIFY AB carries the Pending badge (tertiary-container); the nine booked rows carry none. The badge sits inside the description text so a screen reader announces the suffix rather than skipping a purely visual signal (TC-TXN-010).
empty_state_note: empty keeps the filter chips visible with 'Money in' still active and adds a Clear filters button — this is a FILTERED empty, and the body points at the filter, not the account (TC-TXN-005).
error_variant: Renders the 403 ConsentWithdrawn variant, which hides Retry (TC-TXN-004). The 401 TokenExpired variant on the same surface SHOWS Retry (TC-TXN-003).
search_bar_note: search_field is a search_bar, retyped from text_field on 2026-07-31 — one of only two search_bar uses in the project.
